motion.evidence: Agency/spectacle site whose spectacle is GPU canvas, not scroll-choreography. 0 entrance reveals, 0 stagger, only 4 scroll effects (all pin (fixed): nav, pointer-events overlay, Close [ESC] + CONTACT modals). Continuous motion = 3 <canvas> loops, ~923 rAF/scroll-pass. 12 @keyframes + 10 CSS animation rules; 1 IntersectionObserver (rootMargin 200px, 0 targets at capture); 13 mousemove listeners but 0 cursor-followers (likely feed WebGL camera). Hand-rolled (libraries:[], scriptHits:[]). Transitions: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) x46, 0.06s linear x39. prefers-reduced-motion NOT respected (prmRules:0, craft.a11y.reduced_motion:false) — the chief liability, compounded by always-on canvas. 12 hover effects: nav links color->#ff4d00 (+opacity 1->0.5), case thumbs opacity 0.5->1. a11y: focus_visible true (doubled black+orange focus ring), img_alt_ratio 1, 30/89 small tap targets. Frames captured the page well (s00 hero, s03 logo-wall+case, s06 pink Shop MrBeast case, s09 contact + BSMNT.26 masthead); continuous canvas motion grounded in probe counts, not stills.

notes: Inverted dark theme: near-black #000 ground, off-white #e6e6e6 body (NOT pure white — softens glare on black), pure #fff reserved for emphasis/wordmarks. Single rationed accent #ff4d00 (warm orange) used only on hairline borders + a faint glow shadow; never as a fill. Body type is Geist at a fixed 16px/24px (1.5) across almost the entire page (count 334) — hierarchy is built by SCALE jumps (38px headings -1.52px tracking, 76px display -3.04px tracking), not weight or color. Negative letter-spacing scales with size (tighter as type grows): a deliberate optical-tightening ramp. Zero border-radius everywhere (squared, grotesque/Swiss register). No real shadows except the orange glow micro-accent; the raw rgb(229,231,235) borderColor is a Tailwind preflight default on invisible elements, ignored in favor of the screenshot's dark hairlines. Spacing base is 4px with an editorial macro jump to 56-128px for section rhythm. Two transition systems: a 60ms linear (instant hover feedback / cursor) and a 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) (Material standard) for larger reveals.
